title: Main MES manifest
description: The main portion of the mod manifest, exclusive of input fields.

name.description: The internal name of the mod.

version.description: The mod's internal version number using `semantic versioning <https://semver.org/>`_.

label.description: The user-facing label for the mod as shown in MES.

desc.description: The user-facing description/instructions for the mod as shown in MES.

login.description: Whether the mod requires the user to be logged in to function.

recurs.description: Whether the mod should be applied on recurring page events like infinite scroll.

page.description: The corresponding sidebar page in MES where the mod should be located.

namespace.description: If the mod exposes customizable settings, a fully qualified namespace used to save and retrieve the mod's settings in localStorage.

fields.description: This property is required if the mod wishes to embed input fields in the settings menu. An array of objects describing input fields, one per element. See detailed subschemas below.
